name: Kunieda Maiko
source:
Likes: Her daughter, soccer, dancing
Dislikes: Getting hurt, dirty things, spending lots of money

A mother who works at a men's beauty salon due to hardships. For Maiko, her family is the most important thing in the world, so she is even willing to sell herself in order to support them.
